correctness.rationale: The exact scalar norm profile follows by separating absolute coefficient imbalance from maximum circular chord distance and carefully treating the antipodal saturation. The ratio H_phi(d)/H_theta(d) is monotonically decreasing until one, so the unique scalar sharpness phase is a=-b. Hahn--Banach scalarization proves all complex Banach-operator cases; levelwise matrix specialization proves the cb norm, with exact scalar sharpness.

value.rationale: The recently identified continuum of exotic 2D operator spaces is linked by a canonical and algebraically natural coefficient map. Its exact norm, matrix-amplified norm, sharpness and unique scalar extremizer quantify how a two-generator functional calculus transfers from a narrow spectral arc to a wider one. The same sharp constant holds for arbitrary complex Banach-space operator pencils, providing a complete natural parameter-pair classification rather than a single unmotivated test case. No broader distance-minimization claim is made.
